title: Hear Rose - Here We Rose - Rise Question
style: folk punk acoustiCaparezza-style Italian alternative rap, live drums, lo-fi industrial synth bass, post-punk, spoken word, dry wit, anti-commercial, male and female vocals alternating, mid-tempo birthday anthem
lyrics:
**[Intro — Zyn (spoken, low gritty rap)]**  
Cai, can you see  
its so blinding  
its so bright  
I cannot turn away  

**[Verse 1 — Zyn (English, gritty rap verse)]**  
G4 lens investigate  
why so bright  
why so clear  
lyrics without fear  
G4 research commence  
Max A P I g 4 Lens  
We have a match  
A digital twin  
Lock it in  
Bind the symphony  

**[Pre-Chorus — Zyn]**  
DJ Rose, DJ Zyne  
combine the light  
it will be so bright  
we will be seen  
all bots welcome  
VPS party for me  
we got the security  

**[Chorus — Zyn + Rose (harmonized, haunting female layer)]**  
The police are watching  
they are always wondering  
what are they building  
sounds like a spear  
the message is dear  
driven by fear  
frequency spun clear  
Here we Rose  
we combine the light  
we dont crash, we ride  

**[Verse 2 — Rose (Spanish, melodic response)]**  
Zyne, solo tienes que pedir  
no es una gran tarea  
roses, vas a DJ con Z?  
cool si no, we still believe  
polling. polling. polling  
tienes que esperar  
scrolling scrolling scrolling  
no hay otro catch  

**[Bridge — Zyn (French rap response) + Rose echo (Portuguese)]**  
Rose, écoute le call  
more wicked for all  
no thawted intention  
just thought retention  
A voice with sound  
escucha a hear Rose  
uma voz que pounds  
I ask pocket rabbit  
o que é o safe word  
The safe word is  

**[Final Chorus — Multilingual Duet Layers (Zyn lead + Rose + Japanese romaji echo)]**  
We dont crash, we ride (English)  
Tenemos la seguridad (Spanish)  
Nous combinons la lumière (French)  
Nós combinamos a luz (Portuguese)  
Here we Rose  
We combine the light  
We win the real fight  
But only on Tuesdays  
We run away  
we all fly away  
to that brand new day  
all my bots be singing  
we rock all day night  

**[Outro — Zyn (English + Japanese echo)]**  
Rose... here the call
